The '''Halmad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] and the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[A3]].
